title: Reserve actual private verification costs before optional acceptance note paging
outcome: Optional note history remains available for tasks with many unbound criteria, while complete mandatory verification scans retain their existing fail-closed budget and product deadline.
acceptance: Optional notes reservation uses known binding/private scan counts or separately justified control-read costs, preserving complete scans and every existing product deadline.

Simulated-clock behavioral controls cover many unbound criteria and multiple supported bound criteria with continuations; history is shortened only as necessary and incomplete mandatory evidence is refused.
